properties.notes: The site of the former bus station within the town centre, offering chance for urban infill (see also 2258). A previous permission has now lapsed for a mixed-use development, including 36 apartments covering (across sites 2497 and 2258). This involves reconstruction of an existing building to create 5 dwellings and provision of two apartment blocks providing 16 and 15 apartments respectively (15/02794/FUL). However, it is understood that this particular scheme will not be progressed. Despite this, the site is still considered to be developable in the longer-term. Identified yield recognises location and possibility for a higher density flat/apartment scheme. The extant scheme including consent for a retail unit providing 2,466m2 floorspace (2,402m2 net). Before this, consent for 17 apartments lapsed without implementation (T/20061115). Capacity recorded against site 2258.
